credits.title: Supervised Contact
credits.overview: A young boy's experience in supervised contact sessions with his mother and social worker.

credits.title: Different Now
credits.overview: Abbie meets her best friend’s boyfriend for the first time and is horrified to realise that she already knows him. Big revelations are made as their past comes back to haunt them.

credits.title: Gunplay
credits.overview: In a world of crime bosses, harmless henchman Garry keeps hostages at gunpoint as a threat to those who mean to harm a boss. When Garry's position is threatened, will he betray his moral position and kill the hostage, or do what's right?

credits.title: A Postcard from Bill
credits.overview: The Nazi's have bombed Dover, leaving Gladys fearing for her Husband's life, she seeks reassurance that he is alive in the form of a Postcard.
